## 📋 Pull Request Description
Please provide a summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

Closes # (issue number if applicable)

---

### 🔍 Type of Change
- [ ]  Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ]  New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ]  UI/UX styling improvement
- [ ]  Documentation update
- [ ]  New community plugin or sample extension
- [ ]  New automated tests

---

### 📸 Visual Evidence (Screenshots / Recordings)
If this PR modifies UI, please attach a screenshot or short screen recording.

---

### ✅ Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and ESLint rules of this project (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] All automated tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Production build succeeds without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] I have added tests for my new code where appropriate
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `/docs` if necessary
